[quote=varoshin;61511537]How does one go about joining a continent and veing added to the map?[/quote]
you'll get faster responses on discord. 

Nonetheless: Before making your nation figure out which culture you wanna roll with. This is the continents map; https://i.ibb.co/s9j8zgyt/ERENE-CONTINENTS-OCEANS.png
It shows you which cultures you mostly find in each respective region. I think you can go with for ex. a cultural european nation in Kianzhou (East Asian) but it will take you some good lore and reasoning.

Then fill this template out:
Name:
On-map Name:
Capital:
Government type: (e.g. monarchy, presidential republic, etc.)
Population: (max. 100 million, 50 million for alts)
GDP (Subject to Auditing):
GDP per capita:
Culture Base: (e.g. Russian, English, American)
Religion:
Location: (img link)

and send the filled out template to [nation]Cordone Roleplay Bureau[/nation] via telegram

Also make sure to have read all the rules (especially the join rules) at first, as there are a few restrictions on your starting stats!

If anymore questions DM or ping _crix__ on discord.
Good luck! 👍
